audit_status.source_base: ChatGPT-authored Psalms completion draft using public-domain KJV as familiar alignment scaffold with curated Hebrew/textual overrides; full WLC/OSHB/source-witness audit pending
audit_status.review_note: Longing, thirst, tears, depression-like lament, memory, deep waters, and hope.

verses.restored: As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after thee, O God.

familiar.text: As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after thee, O God.

notes.title: Psalms 42–43
notes.body: Psalms 42 and 43 share a repeated refrain and are widely understood as parts of a single composition. The received Hebrew chapter division is retained while the literary unity is flagged.

modern.text: As the deer pants for streams of water, so my soul longs after You, O God.

original.text: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מַשְׂכִּ֥יל לִבְנֵי קֹֽרַח כְּאַיָּ֗ל תַּעֲרֹ֥ג עַל אֲפִֽיקֵי מָ֑יִם כֵּ֤ן נַפְשִׁ֨י תַעֲרֹ֖ג אֵלֶ֣יךָ אֱלֹהִֽים

verses.restored: My soul thirsteth for God, for the living God: when shall I come and appear before God?

familiar.text: My soul thirsteth for God, for the living God: when shall I come and appear before God?

modern.text: My soul thirsts for God, the living God. When shall I come and appear in God’s presence?

original.text: צָמְאָ֬ה נַפְשִׁ֨י לֵאלֹהִים֮ לְאֵ֪ל חָ֥י מָתַ֥י אָב֑וֹא וְ֝אֵרָאֶ֗ה פְּנֵ֣י אֱלֹהִֽים

verses.restored: My tears have been my meat day and night, while they continually say to me, Where is thy God?

familiar.text: My tears have been my meat day and night, while they continually say unto me, Where is thy God?

modern.text: My tears have been my food both day and night, while men ask me all day long, “Where is your God?”

original.text: הָֽיְתָה לִּ֬י דִמְעָתִ֣י לֶ֭חֶם יוֹמָ֣ם וָלָ֑יְלָה בֶּאֱמֹ֥ר אֵלַ֥י כָּל הַ֝יּ֗וֹם אַיֵּ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: When I remember these things, I pour out my soul in me: for I had gone with the multitude, I went with them to the house of God, with the voice of joy and praise, with a multitude that kept holyday.

familiar.text: When I remember these things, I pour out my soul in me: for I had gone with the multitude, I went with them to the house of God, with the voice of joy and praise, with a multitude that kept holyday.

modern.text: These things come to mind as I pour out my soul: how I walked with the multitude, leading the procession to the house of God with shouts of joy and praise.

original.text: אֵ֤לֶּה אֶזְכְּרָ֨ה וְאֶשְׁפְּכָ֬ה עָלַ֨י נַפְשִׁ֗י כִּ֤י אֶֽעֱבֹ֨ר בַּסָּךְ֮ אֶדַּדֵּ֗ם עַד בֵּ֥ית אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים בְּקוֹל רִנָּ֥ה וְתוֹדָ֗ה הָמ֥וֹן חוֹגֵֽג

verses.restored: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted in me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him for the help of his countenance.

familiar.text: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted in me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him for the help of his countenance.

modern.text: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him for the salvation of His presence.

original.text: מַה תִּשְׁתּ֬וֹחֲחִ֨י נַפְשִׁי֮ וַתֶּהֱמִ֪י עָ֫לָ֥י הוֹחִ֣ילִי לֵֽ֭אלֹהִים כִּי ע֥וֹד אוֹדֶ֗נּוּ יְשׁוּע֥וֹת פָּנָֽיו

verses.restored: O my God, my soul is cast down within me: therefore will I remember thee from the land of Jordan, and of the Hermonites, from the hill Mizar.

familiar.text: O my God, my soul is cast down within me: therefore will I remember thee from the land of Jordan, and of the Hermonites, from the hill Mizar.

modern.text: O my God, my soul despairs within me. Therefore I remember You from the land of Jordan and the peaks of Hermon— even from Mount Mizar.

original.text: אֱֽלֹהַ֗י עָלַי֮ נַפְשִׁ֪י תִשְׁתּ֫וֹחָ֥ח עַל כֵּ֗ן אֶ֭זְכָּרְךָ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ יַרְדֵּ֑ן וְ֝חֶרְמוֹנִ֗ים מֵהַ֥ר מִצְעָֽר

verses.restored: Deep calls to deep at the sound of your waterfalls; all your breakers and your waves have passed over me.

familiar.text: Deep calleth unto deep at the noise of thy waterspouts: all thy waves and thy billows are gone over me.

modern.text: Deep calls to deep in the roar of Your waterfalls; all Your breakers and waves have rolled over me.

original.text: תְּהֽוֹם אֶל תְּה֣וֹם ק֭וֹרֵא לְק֣וֹל צִנּוֹרֶ֑יךָ כָּֽל מִשְׁבָּרֶ֥יךָ וְ֝גַלֶּ֗יךָ עָלַ֥י עָבָֽרוּ

verses.restored: Yet YHWH will command his lovingkindness in the day time, and in the night his song shall be with me, and my prayer to the God of my life.

familiar.text: Yet the LORD will command his lovingkindness in the day time, and in the night his song shall be with me, and my prayer unto the God of my life.

modern.text: The LORD decrees His loving devotion by day, and at night His song is with me as a prayer to the God of my life.

original.text: יוֹמָ֤ם יְצַוֶּ֬ה יְהוָ֨ה חַסְדּ֗וֹ וּ֭בַלַּיְלָה שירה עִמִּ֑י תְּ֝פִלָּ֗ה לְאֵ֣ל חַיָּֽי

verses.restored: I will say to God my rock, Why hast thou forgotten me? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

familiar.text: I will say unto God my rock, Why hast thou forgotten me? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

modern.text: I say to God my Rock, “Why have You forgotten me? Why must I walk in sorrow because of the enemy’s oppression?”

original.text: אוֹמְרָ֤ה לְאֵ֥ל סַלְעִי֮ לָמָ֪ה שְׁכַ֫חְתָּ֥נִי לָֽמָּה קֹדֵ֥ר אֵלֵ֗ךְ בְּלַ֣חַץ אוֹיֵֽב

verses.restored: As with a sword in my bones, mine enemies reproach me; while they say daily to me, Where is thy God?

familiar.text: As with a sword in my bones, mine enemies reproach me; while they say daily unto me, Where is thy God?

modern.text: Like the crushing of my bones, my enemies taunt me, while they say to me all day long, “Where is your God?”

original.text: בְּרֶ֤צַח בְּֽעַצְמוֹתַ֗י חֵרְפ֥וּנִי צוֹרְרָ֑י בְּאָמְרָ֥ם אֵלַ֥י כָּל הַ֝יּ֗וֹם אַיֵּ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.

familiar.text: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.

modern.text: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him, my Savior and my God.

original.text: מַה תִּשְׁתּ֬וֹחֲחִ֨י נַפְשִׁי֮ וּֽמַה תֶּהֱמִ֪י עָ֫לָ֥י הוֹחִ֣ילִי לֵֽ֭אלֹהִים כִּי ע֣וֹד אוֹדֶ֑נּוּ יְשׁוּעֹ֥ת פָּ֝נַ֗י וֵֽאלֹהָֽי

translation_notes: This chapter completes corpus coverage as a ChatGPT-authored draft. KJV is retained as a familiar comparison layer; a separate automated reference pass adds BSB and pointed Hebrew without replacing the restored draft.
safety_note: Emotional despair is voiced without shame. Do not use the refrain to dismiss depression or demand instant recovery.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Psalms witnesses where extant, and other textual witnesses during the global audit. Preserve poetic parallelism, superscriptions, duplicate/parallel psalms, and significant Hebrew/Greek divergences rather than harmonizing them.
